builtinName.description: Name of a builtin module or property thereof; dot notation allowed

builtinPolicy.description: `true` to allow access and `false` to deny access

canonicalName.description: Canonical name of a package representing the shortest path via the dependency tree (or $root$ for a trusted root package)

globalPolicy.description: Globals (including properties using "dot" notation) accessible to the resource; `true` to allow and `false` to deny

globalPolicyRedefine.description: Policy value for a global with "redefine" capability

globalPolicyWrite.description: Policy value for a global with "write" capability

globalProperty.description: Global property key or property thereof; dot notation allowed

include.description: List of canonical names (or $root$) and/or entry paths to forcefully include in the policy

includeEntryByLocation.description: List of locations and optionally relative module paths to forcefully include in the policy

includeEntryByLocationLocation.description: Relative path to directory containing a `package.json`, relative to the policy override file; cannot ascend above project root

includeEntryByName.description: List of canonical names and optionally relative module paths to forcefully include in the policy

includeEntryModules.description: Module paths relative to the policy override file to forcefully include in generated policy; if omitted, the `.` path is implied

includeEntryName.description: Canonical name of package (must be present in dependency tree)

nativePolicy.description: `true` to allow loading of native modules; `false` for none

packagePolicy.description: Additional external packages (in their entirety) accessible to the module; `true` to allow and `false` to deny

resourceMetadataKey.description: Key for a resource metadata entry

resourceMetadataValue.description: Value for a resource metadata entry

builtin.description: Mapping of builtin module name to builtin policy value

packages.description: Mapping of canonical package name (or $root$) to package policy value

resources.description: Mapping of canonical package name (or "$root$") to resource policy value

rootName.description: Resource name of the entry package ($root$)

usePolicy.description: Reference to resource policy to use for the application root
